EVIDENCE / SOURCE BY SOURCE

Oura Ring 4 research.
Evidence you can inspect.

Read the source behind a claim, the generation it concerns and the limits of what it establishes.

How to interpret Oura Ring 4 research

Product, materials and sizing

Oura Ring 4 support specifications. Manufacturer source for titanium Ring 4, recessed sensors, size range, typical battery life and care limits. Ceramic Ring 4 uses different external material.

Membership and recurring costs

Oura Membership support. Detailed insights require membership. Pricing varies by region; check Singapore billing terms before purchasing.

Smart Sensing evidence

Oura’s Smart Sensing article describes an August 2024 comparison involving 60 participants. It is manufacturer-reported research comparing Ring 4, Gen3 and reference equipment. The reported measures do not establish one universal accuracy percentage or a guaranteed health outcome.

Singapore audience context

MOH’s NPHS 2024 release and HealthHub sleep guidance provide wellness context. They do not prove demand for Oura or willingness to pay.

Selected buying destination

OURA SG on Shopee. We recovered six Ring 4 finish listings and seven Ring 5 product/kit links. Indexed Silver, Brushed Silver, Stealth, Gold and Rose Gold pages still showed “Sold Out” when rechecked on 10 November 2026; Black could not be fetched. This is indexed evidence, not a live inventory feed. Some Shopee checks require login. Current purchasable Ring 4 stock remains unconfirmed; verify your size and finish before purchasing.

Historical Ring 4 sizing-kit listing is separately identified. Do not substitute a Ring 5 kit for a Ring 4 choice.

Availability and the sales plan

Marketplace presence does not establish current buyability. Do not start a paid Ring 4 campaign until an orderable size/finish, seller terms and fulfilment are confirmed. Oura lists Harvey Norman Singapore as a retail partner, which is a separate buying route; we have not verified its current size-specific stock. A retailer page is not a replacement for the assignment’s Shopee/Lazada requirement. Product generation or seller changes need fresh marketplace verification.

Original content and design

The code, procedural artwork and copy are original. ORYZO by Lusion informed product-centred motion and editorial presentation; its code and media were not reused. Charts and product breakdowns on this site are labelled illustrations.

Persona research status

The three persona routes represent proposed needs: understanding sleep, interpreting recovery and keeping an everyday activity routine. They have not been validated by interviews. No customer testimonials, expert endorsements or survey results have been invented.

SEO and structured data

Visible FAQs answer buying questions. Optional FAQPage markup describes those same answers; it is not a promise of a Google rich result. Google retired FAQ rich results in 2026.

Review date and marketing target

Desk research reviewed 10 November 2026. The campaign target remains a 20% relative sales improvement within three calendar months, measured against a comparable seller-confirmed baseline. Guide requests and Shopee clicks are supporting indicators, not proof of sales.
